Odoo 20 · app icon redesign · minimal neumorphism · option C

Pill: a raised button, a quiet mark, one hue per app

Every application icon in Odoo 20 Community and Enterprise as a pastel tile of the app's own hue carrying a raised circular button; inside it a small one-colour glyph with a familiar, literal metaphor (calculator, factory, headset, ID badge, cart…). The set ships inside the identity debranding module, which swaps the icons in the home menu, the navbar, the Apps list, the Settings sidebar and the PWA shortcuts.

93icons
44in Community & Enterprise
49Enterprise only
82distinct hues
System

Tile anatomy

  • Ground 512 × 512, radius 116 (22.6 %, Odoo's own tile ratio). A pastel gradient of the app hue with a blurred light rim top-left and a soft dark rim bottom-right.
  • Pill a 352 px circle raised from the ground by two soft shadows — white (−7, −7) and hue-dark (+9, +11, 28 %) — the one neumorphic element on the tile.
  • Glyph one colour (the app hue, light-to-dark gradient) with cut-outs in the pill tint; no accents, no second tone, so the mark stays quiet and reads at 24 px.
  • Metaphors literal and conventional: Accounting is a calculator, Manufacturing a factory, Helpdesk a headset, Employees an ID badge, eCommerce a cart, Inventory a box.
  • Format SVG (filters render natively in every browser); 192 px PNG rasters back Safari's home-screen icons.

Tones from one hue

tile

Shown for CRM (#E5533F). Hues stay in the family of the Odoo category (Sales warm, Finance green, Supply Chain indigo, HR amber, Services teal, Productivity violet, Marketing pink, Website blue, Administration slate) but every app gets its own, so neighbours never look alike.
